headline: As of 2026-09-22: 10,572 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 3 of 50 states, D+50.4 registration lean.
bullets: 10,572 early/mail ballots cast so far across 3 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+50.4 by registration.
Most ballots cast: North Carolina (7,445), Pennsylvania (2,519), Florida (608).
